hook: Tammidikunta lake grows to *29.3 acres* after Hydraa restoration
hook_b: Tammidikunta lake grows to *29.3 acres* after Hydraa restoration
tldr: CM Revanth Reddy inaugurates the restored Tammidikunta lake in Madhapur at 6 pm on Wednesday, Nov 11.

beats.what: Hydraa removed 30,000 truckloads of silt and built a 1.6 km walkway, open-air gym and play area.
beats.why: The lake had shrunk to 16.2 acres and was used as a dump for debris, garbage and biomedical waste.
beats.care: A new public lakefront with a walking track opens in Madhapur; Hydraa says it will also help control monsoon flooding.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Siasat: Hydraa invited actor Nagarjuna for 'extending support' to the lake's development.

cards.q: Would you use a lakefront walkway like Tammidikunta's?

qs: Who maintains a restored lake once the inauguration is over?

*34 people* who lost huts at Ramanthapur Pedda Cheruvu get Indiramma house papers at the event.
